note: Andorra keeps no visa requirements of its own and is reached only through France or Spain, so a traveller needing a Schengen visa needs a multiple-entry one: a visitor meets the EU's common list (the eu1806 list).

sources.title: Wikipedia, Schengen Area: territories and European microstates
sources.said: Access to the Principality of Andorra is restricted to road or helicopter transport through the neighbouring Schengen Area members, France and Spain . ... The country does not maintain its own visa requirements, EU citizens may enter with a national identity card or passport , while all other nationalities require a valid passport or equivalent.
